verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an observability SaaS with an agent, CLI and SDKs, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to opt out of Datadog's own telemetry or usage tracking. Related items such as Sensitive Data Scanner or Audit Trail are different features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
